description: Create a professional noise violation evidence log from scattered incident notes. Open the raw notes at /home/ga/Documents/noise_incidents_raw.txt and create a structured spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Noise_Violation_Log.xlsx. The spreadsheet must include columns for: Date, Day of Week, Start Time, End Time, Duration (hrs), Violation Type, During Quiet Hours?, Description, and Action Taken. Calculate durations using formulas. Add summary statistics (total incidents, total hours, violations during quiet hours). Sort chronologically. Apply professional formatting with borders and bold headers. Building quiet hours are 10PM-8AM (weekdays) and 11PM-9AM (weekends).
